name: stream-racer-api
description: Tests for the Stream Racer API mod: xunit for the pure C# logic, Vitest against the running game, Playwright for the control page.

scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:api
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:ui && pnpm run test:race
scripts.hooks: cp scripts/post-commit .git/hooks/post-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/post-commit && echo hooks installed
